_comment: Canonical naming for Meridian. Single source of truth. Edit ONLY this file when renaming.
tagline: A 3D Earth drawn from real vector borders, rendered on WebGPU with a WebGL2 fallback.
notes: Repo slug stays region-earth (the working name); the product is called Meridian on screen.
Static, no build step. Vercel serves the committed files and runs nothing.
Geography is regenerated by build/make-geo.mjs and committed to data/. The npm sources it reads are gitignored; re-fetch them before re-running it.
